topic: Garling had twin sons with Magnolia on God Valley, then told her he was marrying someone else, beat her when she resisted, and walked away without confirming whether she survived
title: Garling Left His Twin Sons And Never Looked Back
description: A woman named Magnolia fell for Garling on God Valley and gave birth to his twin sons: Shamrock and Shanks. She believed he'd come back and they'd be a real family. Garling came back to tell her he was marrying someone else, struck her down when she protested, and abandoned her to her fate.
comment: Did Garling deliberately abandon his own sons, or was he just indifferent to whether they lived or died?

lines.text: Garling met a local woman named Magnolia on God Valley and hid his true identity from her completely.

lines.text: Chapter 1160: he returned and told her he was marrying someone else and her home would be destroyed.
When she wouldn't let it go, Garling struck her down on the spot and walked away.

shot.fallback: noble turning away from a fallen woman

lines.text: He didn't even confirm if she survived. He had Marines to order, and she was no longer useful.

shot.fallback: indifferent figure walking away without looking back

lines.text: Dragon, a young Marine cadet, found her and chose to save her twins instead of following orders.
That single moment of mercy is the only reason Shanks ever got off that island alive at all.

shot.fallback: merciful choice becoming a child's lifeline

lines.text: Garling never knew what happened to her, and he never came back to find out...
